moment: A Western town notice board: aged papers nailed to rough planks with one large blank poster in front, like a wanted-poster wall
why: Weathered paper tacked to a clapboard shack with a dusty street at the edge is a standard Old West bounty-board look, strongly associated with RDR2.

moment: A classroom chalkboard in a sunbeam with a chalk drone and a row of bars
why: Wood-framed green chalkboard and diagonal sunlight read as an Indian engineering classroom; not unique on its own, but matches the clearly marked classroom frames later.

moment: The closing scene at Pangong lake: a yellow scooter parked on the pebble shore with Himalayan mountains behind
why: Yellow Vespa-style scooter on a high-altitude blue lake shore is the film's ending image; the row of small boxes above looks like a UI progress rail.

moment: A frontier camp at sunset: covered wagon, tethered horses, wall tents, a cooking pot over a campfire, a lake and mountains
why: This composition is very close to the gang camp in RDR2.

moment: A hobby quadcopter hovering in a college courtyard beside a concrete colonnade
why: Alone it is only a drone and a brutalist campus; the architecture is consistent with the Indian engineering-college classroom frames in the set. Low confidence.

moment: A dark ghost ship dissolving into shadow, a brass compass above a dashed waypoint line
why: The same tattered-sail pirate ship, with a compass and waypoint line suggesting a treasure map.

moment: Candles floating in a starry night sky like the Great Hall ceiling, with a quill-like line at lower left
why: Wax candles suspended upright in a field of stars is the Great Hall signature.

moment: Same star field with candles and quill strokes repeated down the page, like lines of writing on parchment
why: Floating candles and star field again; the repeating feather strokes suggest writing lines.

moment: A stormy night sea with a glowing teal swell, a lone tall ship on the horizon and a compass on the right
why: Bioluminescent teal wave under dark storm clouds with a distant sailing ship reads as a pirate seascape; could also be Sea of Thieves.

moment: A leather-journal spread: pencil sketches of pines, a lake, a saddled horse, a ladder, and a taped-in note
why: Pencil sketchbook with taped notes and horse and camp scenery matches Arthur Morgan's journal in RDR2.

moment: Hogwarts castle on its cliff above a dark lake with floating candles and a broomstick in the foreground
why: Gothic spires, reflecting lake, floating candles and a broom are unmistakable.

moment: Dusk at a mountain camp: a wall tent with a lantern, a hanging cooking pot over a campfire, a covered wagon and a snowy ridge
why: Canvas tent, tripod pot, crates and covered wagon match the RDR2 camp look.

moment: The Hogwarts Express steaming across the Glenfinnan Viaduct above a Highland loch
why: Scarlet steam train on a curved stone viaduct with a loch is the film's iconic shot.

moment: The journal again: sketched horse, pines and lake, with a hand-drawn grid of boxes crossed out
why: Same journal pages; the crossed-out grid looks like a scribbled-out sketch.

moment: A storm sea with a breaking wave above a treasure-map panel: compass, dashed route, skull-and-gear marker, an X
why: Skull emblem, compass and dashed route to an X are classic pirate-map visuals.

moment: A classroom desk with a fine pen in a velvet box beside a pocket stopwatch, chalk drone above
why: Prized pen and stopwatch on a lecture-hall desk fit the dean's props from the film, but nothing in this frame is unique on its own.

moment: Pangong lake at sunset, the yellow scooter circled and ticked
why: Same lake and yellow scooter as the film's ending.

moment: A blood-red dusk over a ranch with a gnarled oak, a farmhouse and fence, with X marks floating in the sky
why: Crimson Western dusk with crosshair-like marks looks like a Dead Eye scene.

moment: The Great Hall: long house tables with goblets, floating candles overhead, a tall Gothic window
why: Tables, goblets and floating candles under high arches are unmistakable.

moment: The Black Pearl or Flying Dutchman at night under a moon in fog, a dotted route with an X along the waterline
why: Tattered black sails, lantern-lit stern gallery and a dotted treasure route.

moment: A wooden notice board in a Western town with aged papers and one big blank poster
why: Same bounty-board look.

moment: The Great Hall with floating candles and long tables, a thin progress line at the bottom
why: Same Great Hall composition.

moment: A drone hovering by a concrete and stone college colonnade
why: Weak signal alone; the architecture matches the classroom frames in the set.

moment: A crimson Western dusk with a drawn route line through four X-shaped targets and crows overhead
why: Red landscape with a path and crosshair marks recalls RDR2 map or Dead Eye.

moment: A tall ship on the horizon at sunset on a dark sea, above a treasure-map panel
why: Lone sailing ship at sea plus compass, dashed route, skull-gear and an X.

moment: Golden sunset over a river valley with a horse grazing and an oak in silhouette
why: Painterly Western vista with a lone horse looks like a Western open-world game screenshot.

moment: A concrete lecture hall with a chalk drone and the words 'AAL IZZ WEL' running off the board
why: The chalk slogan is the film's catchphrase, in an Indian engineering-college hall.

moment: The ghost ship in darkness with an inked treasure map overlaid: dotted route, X, an island outline and a compass star
why: Same ship with a pirate-map panel laid over it.

moment: A moonlit harbour at night with masts and lantern-lit quay buildings, above a treasure-route panel
why: Tall ships at a lantern-lit port under a moon read as Port Royal or Tortuga.

moment: A night camp: a campfire between two canvas tents on dark grassland under mountains
why: Tents, fire and fireflies at night match RDR2's camp at night.

moment: Golden sunset across a valley with a grazing horse
why: Same vista as the earlier sunset frame.

moment: A candlelit dark room with floating candles and a parchment on the floor with glowing ink cracks, like the Marauder's Map unfolding
why: Candles and old parchment in a gothic space evoke Hogwarts; the glowing crack pattern is unclear.

moment: A bioluminescent teal wave in a night storm, a lone ship on the horizon, a compass on the right
why: Same stormy teal sea and ship.

moment: A fine pen in a velvet-lined box beside a pocket stopwatch on a classroom desk
why: Same classroom world; props match the dean's pen and stopwatch, but the frame is not unique alone.

moment: The Black Pearl or Flying Dutchman under a full moon, with a brass compass hanging above
why: Ragged black sails, lantern-lit stern and moonlit fog.

moment: The Marauder's Map: folded parchment with ink corridors and pairs of footprints walking across
why: Footprints on folded aged parchment with drawn walls and corridors is the Marauder's Map.

moment: The Marauder's Map unfolded: a ribbon banner, compass-rose corners and footprints near the top
why: Same map, now with the banner and footprints in the corners.

moment: Floating candles in a dark starry space, with one candle framed by teal brackets and a white pill button below
why: Floating candles again; the brackets and button are interface elements.

moment: The lecture hall with a chalk drone and 'AAL IZZ WELL' on the blackboard
why: The catchphrase is written on the board in an Indian engineering-college hall.
